country.name: Djibouti
country.jurisdictionNotice: School education and vocational training are governed through MENFOP and its competent services; higher education is governed separately. Institution, site, program, instructor and award claims must remain distinct.
country.languagePolicy: Arabic and French are official languages. Somali and Afar have distinct national, community and educational contexts. Language, script, locality, curriculum approval and community review must be preserved; translation is not localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Djiboutian reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, territorial service or institution.

governanceModel.summary: MENFOP governs school education, vocational formation and the services within its current mandate; the ministry responsible for higher education governs public and private higher education.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official institution name and identifier, region, locality, level, sector, authorization or declaration, services, current operating status and source date. A service workflow, statistical enumeration or examination result is not a current comprehensive authorization directory.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Institution opening, extension or modification, exact program accreditation, instructor authorization, diploma authority, campus and current validity are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry of National Education and Vocational Training (MENFOP)
authorities.role: school education, vocational training, administration and assigned examinations

authorities.name: Inspectorate-General of National Education
authorities.role: inspection, official education documentation and quality oversight within its mandate

authorities.name: CRIPEN and competent curriculum services
authorities.role: curriculum, pedagogical resources and education research within their mandates

authorities.name: MENFOP planning and statistics services
authorities.role: education statistics, school mapping and planning

authorities.name: Regional education and school-management services
authorities.role: territorial school administration and current institution-record validation

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Higher Education and Research
authorities.role: public and private higher-education institution and program oversight

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Women and Family

curriculum.authority: MENFOP, CRIPEN and the competent curriculum services
curriculum.title: Official programs by cycle, class, subject, stream and language
curriculum.implementationRule: A ministry announcement, inspectorate resource page, textbook, examination notice or teacher resource is not the controlling curriculum. Verify cycle, class, subject or vocational stream, language, approving instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Law, program, syllabus, assessment reference, approved material, teacher guide and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: MENFOP and the responsible regional or school-management service
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: The service portal documents school-management, private-school accreditation or declaration and teacher-authorization workflows. It is not itself a complete public directory of currently authorized and operating schools. Verify each institution through the competent MENFOP record.
requiredRecordFields: record date, source and review date

educationStatistics.authority: MENFOP planning and statistics services and INStAD
educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The MENFOP 2018–2019 yearbook and INStAD 2022 tables are dated statistical sources, not current directories. Each value must preserve observation or school year, table source, definition, level, sector, geography, denominator and publication date. A 2025–2026 inspectorate document requires document-level provenance review before use.

vocationalQualifications.authority: MENFOP and the competent vocational-training authority
vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: Training-provider licence or renewal, exact program approval, occupational standard, examination authority, qualification and award authority are separate claims. Verify provider, site, program, modality, decision and validity.

higherEducation.authority: Ministry responsible for Higher Education and Research
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Authorization to open, extend or modify an institution does not accredit every program. Exact program accreditation, instructor authorization, diploma authority, campus, capacity, validity and current status must be verified separately. Private issuance of higher-education awards remains limited to the scope authorized by the State.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: No verified comprehensive current Djibouti personal-data protection statute was located in this review
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: No verified operational comprehensive personal-data supervisory authority was located in this review
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: Applicable child-rights, family, criminal, education and protection instruments and current ministry procedures
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Do not infer Djibouti law from another jurisdiction. A current legal review must verify lawful basis, sensitive and biometric data, learner rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents. The exact consolidated child-protection framework plus current education-sector reporting, referral, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures must be verified before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: French, Arabic, Somali and Afar have distinct official, instructional, national and community roles. Script, variety, locality, curriculum approval, terminology and community review must be preserved. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Djiboutian education reviewer is named.
MENFOP, vocational, territorial and higher-education responsibilities are verified under the current organization.
A verified current comprehensive public school directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year, table source, definition, level, sector, geography and publication date.
Every curriculum record preserves cycle, class, subject or stream, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies institution, exact program, instructor, award, campus, capacity, decision and validity.
A current Djibouti personal-data legal review and child-safeguarding procedure review are approved before a real learner pilot.
French, Arabic, Somali and Afar resources preserve their distinct linguistic and local contexts.
